comment: The titles of the STB simulator's video on demand application: MPEG-DASH streams, played with dash.js. The films are open films, freely available as DASH streams on the internet; each entry names who serves the stream and the film's licence. The test title is on the device (target/media/build-abr.sh), so that the application can be used, and checked, where the target cannot reach the internet; its second entry is the same title over a path that the simulator serves slowly.

titles.name: Big Buck Bunny
titles.about: A giant rabbit takes on three bullying rodents. The Blender Foundation's second open film.

titles.name: Elephants Dream
titles.about: Two men explore a vast machine. The first open film, by the Orange Open Movie Project.
titles.served_by: BBC Research & Development's DASH test streams
titles.licence: (c) Blender Foundation, Netherlands Media Art Institute, orange.blender.org, CC BY 2.5

titles.name: Sintel
titles.about: A girl searches for the baby dragon she befriended. The Blender Foundation's third open film.

titles.name: Tears of Steel
titles.about: A group of warriors and scientists try to save the world from robots. The fourth open film.

titles.name: Test pattern
titles.about: A test stream on this device, in three sizes (240p, 480p, 720p). The colour of the block at the top centre names the size that is playing.

titles.name: Test pattern, slow network
titles.about: The same test stream over a connection of 0.6 Mbit/s, which carries only its smallest size.
